reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and the existing sync pipeline, while all six linking handlers share the new link checks.

duplication.why: The diff adds copies of the provider linking workflow, Akahu transaction downloader, and unlinkAccount's local field-clearing block.

placement.why: Provider integration follows the existing module boundaries, although link validation and local detachment would fit better as explicit operations in accounts/link.ts.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested linking rules, Fintegra integration, and corresponding release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralized checks help maintenance, but an assertion-named helper now mutates accounts and duplicated linking, downloading, and detachment logic creates additional maintenance points.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing bank lookup and sync abstractions are used; unlinkAccount includes provider cleanup that takeover explicitly must avoid, and no separate local-detachment helper exists.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated Fintegra workflows and account-clearing block are direct, recognizable copies rather than structurally disguised implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere gains replaceExistingLink and expands into validation plus detachment; its conditional branches cover duplicate refusal, the upgradingId gate, and closed-target rejection, while all six linking handlers call it.
